name: DOMRect and getClientRects metrics
plain: Measures element boxes at subpixel precision, including text, emoji and ranges.
meaning: Sizes of text and emoji boxes depend on installed fonts, text shaping, zoom and OS, giving a hash that works even when canvas is blocked.

steps: Insert off-screen elements with odd fonts and emoji

data.metric: Floats with up to 10 decimal places per measurement

limits.headline: Can measure text and emoji boxes to spot your fonts and system
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens when the page loads
can: Measure the size of hidden text and emoji down to tiny fractions
Turn the sizes into a number that depends on your fonts, zoom and system
Work even when canvas checks are blocked
cannot: Show you anything on the screen
Give a clear result if the browser adds noise or rounds the sizes

story.what_it_is: A script measures the exact size of text and boxes on the page, down to tiny fractions of a pixel.

marketing.name: getBoundingClientRect
marketing.pitch: Returns the size and position of an element, which sites use for layout, tooltips and animation.

story.for_you: You see nothing. The page places invisible text, measures it, and the tiny numbers depend on your fonts, zoom and screen. Together they act like a fine detail fingerprint of your setup.
story.for_makers: Layout code needs these numbers all the time, for menus, tooltips, drag and drop and animation. Trackers reuse the same call because tiny rounding differences reveal your system.

use_cases.example: A document editor like Google Docs measures text to decide where lines and pages break.
A design tool such as Figma measures shapes and text boxes to snap them neatly to each other.
A browser game checks where UI boxes sit so a click lands on the right button.
A fraud tool measures the same emoji at many sizes and compares to known real devices, to spot an emulator.
A tracker measures the same text across fonts and adds the result to a device ID.
A product page measures a size chart to show a hover zoom exactly over the right part of the image.
A screen magnifier extension reads boxes to move focus accurately around a page.

risks: Hard to block without breaking layout

technical_bounds: Deterministic per font and zoom stack, so entropy is bounded by fonts and DPR

value.abuse: Canvas fallback fingerprint, zoom and DPR detection
